summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by foreign private issuer Alpha Compute Corp (Nasdaq: ALP) providing a business update. It discloses unaudited financials ($79.2M assets, $23M projected annual revenue), reports completion of the GAMEE acquisition, and operational progress of GPU clusters. No specific special-situation event is announced; it is a routine operational and financial update. No deal terms are stated. This is not an activist campaign, strategic review, or other special situation category.
